prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) was helpful (+3.3% to +5.5%), but placing it after the adoption certificate caused a severe drop (-22.4%).
Specific layout redesigns (Stage, Scroll, Grid, Checklist), select new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration), desktop prompts, and targeted hints/clarifications were helpful.
Several layout redesigns (e.g., Photo Upload Grid/Card, Split Pick Friend, Waiting Spotlight) and new setup flows severely degraded performance (-4.8% to -23.3%).
Copy updates, incentives, audio cues, notification toggles, waiting screen components, and several new screens (Placement Guide, Troubleshooter, Bio Preview, Controls Overview) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, projecting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or degraded conversion.
Predictions were often too low for winning changes, projecting negative or modest impact (-5.0% to +3.7%) on features that delivered large gains (up to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] New Desktop Control Preview Screen: Add a new screen 'new_controls_preview' right before home_intro that introduces basic interaction shortcuts and desktop pet visibility controls. (why: Support mail showed multiple complaints from users post-onboarding who were unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Pre-Waiting Desktop Sound Verification Flow: Introduce an interactive sound test component on the waiting screen so users can verify desktop sound effects while pet generation finishes. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s). Providing interactive audio feedback keeps users engaged while waiting.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Companion Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after selecting a companion in pick_friend. (why: Earlier lessons showed moving sign-in earlier after selection improved conversion by up to +5.5% without causing severe drop-offs.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Persistence Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing into an existing account restores saved pet profiles and data. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or resetting after signing back in. Clear messaging prevents sign-in drop-off.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Account Continuity Headline Update: Update the choose_path headline to highlight quick desktop setup and instant pet adoption. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s. Clear headline messaging accelerates early user decision-making.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Generation Time Counter: Enable the active time estimate display and a subtle timer component on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step has a very long mean time of 2336s. Active time feedback reduces drop-off from perceived app freezing.)
6: [adoption, notification] Adoption Certificate Background System Notification Prompt: Prompt users to enable desktop notifications on the adoption certificate screen while final setup processes. (why: The adoption step takes a median of 89s (mean 1017s), leading users to leave the app window during processing.)
7: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Screen Redesign: Change home_intro layout to split view featuring an animated pet mascot on one side and a completion checklist on the other. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 40.9%. A visually engaging split layout on the final screen ensures users finish setup.)

scores.note: New preview screens for controls perform well (+3.5% avg), addressing reported post-onboarding user confusion.
New setup flows on waiting steps severely degraded performance in past tests (-4.8% to -23.3%).
Reordering sign-in immediately after selection proved consistently effective (+3.3% to +5.5%).
Targeted sign-in hints backed by support complaints perform well (+2.6% historical average).
Copy changes on choose_path yield very marginal gains (+0.4% in prior tests).
Waiting screen components and time displays show minimal effect (+0.3% over 4 tests).
Notification prompts during setup showed no positive effect and historically degraded conversion (-1.6%).
Finish step layout redesigns historically resulted in minor negative lift (-0.8%).
